parsed_json.sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN activities act ON act.molregno = md.molregno JOIN assays a ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON td.tid = a.tid JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = md.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL261' ORDER BY md.chembl_id
